newsitem.title: UK: London Clearing House ups spot IPE gas oil margin.
newsitem.headline: London Clearing House ups spot IPE gas oil margin.

text.p: The London Clearing House (LCH) raised spot month top-up margins on the IPE gas oil contract with effect from the close of business on Thursday, November 7.

In a statement to IPE clearing members the LCH said the spot month top-up for gas oil has been increased to $700 per lot from $300, and will take immediate effect for the November 1996 gas oil delivery.

"This will be reflected in the margin calls on 8 November 1996," the statement said. "This decision has been taken in view of the continued high level of open interest in the November 1996 gas oil future," it added.
Open interest for November gas oil futures was 23,779 lots (equivalent to 2.38 million tonnes) by the close on Thursday. The contract expires on Tuesday next week.
